state.request: Fix the deferred Factory Bots review findings and reinstall: retry one failed ticket detail read; preserve a non-default FACTORY_URL in the offline start command; pass a minimal environment to the MCP child and fail pending calls on stdout/stderr errors; keep one poll loop across route changes; remove the unused storage path from the board snapshot; make a missing MCP script an actionable config error; add focused regression tests; rebuild, install, and reload the plugin.

sizeDecision.reason: The seven criteria are one hardening pass over the same service, MCP client, and panel; each slice alone would leave the verified board with a known review finding. Keep it one feature.

lifecycle.riskRequest: The MCP child receives only a minimal base environment plus the config's `env`; a sentinel secret in the BB process is not visible to the child. A stdout or stderr pipe error rejects in-flight calls and stops the child instead of becoming an unhandled rejection.
